title: AgentOutputContract
description: Universal output envelope that every Finance X agent must wrap its results in. Ensures all outputs are traceable, evidence-backed, and reviewable.

output_id.description: Unique identifier for this output (UUID v4).

agent_id.description: ID of the agent that produced this output.

task_id.description: ID of the task contract this output fulfills.

company_ticker.description: BIST ticker this output is about.

confidence_overall.description: Overall confidence for this entire output.

claims.description: Structured list of factual claims made in this output.

warnings.description: Non-blocking issues the downstream consumer must be aware of.

missing_inputs.description: Inputs that were expected but unavailable. Each reduces confidence.

contradictions_detected.description: Contradictions found within this output or relative to prior outputs.

review_decision_id.description: ID of the review decision if reviewed.

payload.description: The actual agent-specific output content. Schema defined in each agent's output_schema.json.

findings.description: Structured review findings this output raises about upstream work or its own gaps. Phase 4A observe-only — consumed by schema-shadow-validator to check addressed_findings coverage. Shape is canonical; enforcement path is progressive (observe → shadow-warn → hard).

finding_id.description: Stable id referenced by downstream addressed_findings.

target_agent.description: Which agent SHOULD address this finding (optional — default: the agent just downstream).

required_action.description: Concrete instruction for the remediating agent.

canonical_refs.description: Canonical rule ids (MM-01, OI-002, …) this finding maps to.

addressed_findings.description: Acknowledgement of each upstream finding this output was asked to address. finding_id set equality with the source findings[] is enforced by the shadow validator (Phase 4A observe-only, promoted in later phases).

metrics_array.description: Canonical 28-metric catalogue (MM-01..MM-28 from canonical/rules/mandatory_metrics.yaml). financial_analysis must emit all 28; other agents may emit a subset. Phase 4A observe-only — shadow validator computes presence/completeness, no runtime gate.

value.description: null allowed when confidence='blocked' per NH-001..006.

period.description: Fiscal period this value pertains to.

engine_snapshot.description: OI-002: engine_snapshot keys MUST be a subset of metrics_array[].id — i.e. the deterministic engine's view of what it calculated. Shadow validator already enforces the subset check (Phase 3A); Phase 4A adds the canonical shape.

interpretations.description: Structured narrative blocks with canonical depth floors. observation ≥ 80 chars, reasoning ≥ 120, counterargument ≥ 60, implication ≥ 80. Shadow validator enforces per Phase 3A.

counterargument.description: Top-level counterargument when a single interpretation is produced (e.g. final_summary, strategic_synthesis). interpretations[].counterargument is preferred when multiple blocks exist.

implication.description: Top-level implication when a single interpretation is produced. Same preference rule as counterargument.
